text:
Sophie L: Quick sync — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/9082 is ready to merge but it's blocking Thursday's cut. We need two approvers with +1 and upkeep signoff before Thu 10:00 UTC. CI is green and local smoke passed. Can @alex, @maria, or @jay spare an eyeball? :pray:
Alex G: I'll take a look in 20m, heads-up on the kv-cache touchpoint.
Maria H: on PTO till tomorrow morning, but I can do a quick pass if it's small. What's the risk matrix? 
Sophie L: It's a small behavioral change for prefix caching - low-risk but sensitive to cold-start perf. Checklist: 1) CI green 2) perf smoke 3) infra approval for config bump 4) product signoff if behavior change.
Jay P: I can give one LGTM once infra signs off. pinging @Priya for infra review.
Priya S: Reviewing now — it's a config change plus a tiny runtime guard. Running perf smoke locally.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window for Thu 10:00 UTC exists. Note: merges after 09:30 UTC may miss validation cutover.
Alex G: Reviewed. left one nit about a log msg, not blocking. Suggest rewording to `debug -> info` for easier rollback tracing. LGTM after that.
Priya S: infra ok. Verified config thresholds and rollback flag present. :thumbsup: 
Sophie L: Thanks all — Alex LGTM, Priya infra-ok. We still need one more approver (product/behavior). @maria are you able to confirm before 09:30 UTC tomorrow?
Maria H: Just looked — behavior seems safe and covered by tests. Approving now. LGTM from product.
Sophie L: Awesome — got 2x approvals and infra signoff. I'll merge at 09:15 UTC to let validation run. Will call out in #eng-releases after merge. :shipit:
Jay P: cheers, thanks Sophie.
Sophie L: merged at 09:16 UTC, smoke passed, tagging release notes and closing the thread.
